as_told.title: AATIP studied craft that manipulate the spacetime metric

plain: Hal Puthoff, a scientist described as a CIA expert on UFOs, says that from about 2007 to 2012 he worked with AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, and that the best the team could do was take Einstein's general relativity, the theory that treats space and time as a fabric that can bend, as the working theory for how these objects, called UAP or unidentified anomalous phenomena, might move. Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who says he was part of that office, credits Puthoff and goes further, saying that bending space and time this way was not just a possibility but the core theory they worked from. If true, it would mean the government seriously considered that these craft travel by warping space itself.
